limitations: Mixed-vintage datasets are not a contemporaneous condition survey.
Each tile samples a 30m source pixel at its center, rather than aggregating all land cover in its footprint.
Forested wetlands use the forest symbol; scrub and emergent wetlands use marsh. Shore is not necessarily sand; other open land is not necessarily meadow.
Developed cells are land-cover classes, not individual buildings or residents.
Elevation, salinity, source boundary conditions, tree ages, events and intervention effects are game assumptions.
